topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, I can see the joy in your eyes as you talk about your gardening plans. The idea of vibrant greens and blooming flowers sharing our space warms my heart. I’d be delighted to let you use part of the yard. I think the spot near the fence, where the sun shines just right, would be perfect. We can mark it out together, and I can help clear the area if you’d like. It’s wonderful to share this space and see it come alive with your touch. Just let me know when you’re ready to start, and we can go from there. Looking forward to seeing how everything grows!
